definitions.explanation: A state of mind that has lost its normal balance and reason; also, conduct so extreme it seems insane.

examples.japanese: {狂気|きょうき}の{沙汰|さた}だ。
examples.english: It's an act of sheer madness.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{狂気|きょうき}を{描|えが}いた{映画|えいが}。
examples.english: A film depicting the madness of war.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{目|め}には{狂気|きょうき}じみた{光|ひかり}が{宿|やど}っていた。
examples.english: There was a crazed gleam in his eyes.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狂気|きょうき}の{沙汰|さた}: a crazy thing to do; sheer madness
- {狂気|きょうき}じみた: crazed; bordering on insane
- {狂気|きょうき}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into madness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正気|しょうき}: sanity — the direct antonym
- {異常|いじょう}: abnormality — broader; not limited to the mind
